props.name: UV Smooth
props.description: Controls how smoothing is applied to UVs

items.name: None
items.description: UVs are not smoothed, boundaries are kept sharp

items.name: Keep Corners
items.description: UVs are smoothed, corners on discontinuous boundary are kept sharp

items.name: Keep Corners, Junctions
items.description: UVs are smoothed, corners on discontinuous boundary and junctions of 3 or more regions are kept sharp

items.name: Keep Corners, Junctions, Concave
items.description: UVs are smoothed, corners on discontinuous boundary, junctions of 3 or more regions and darts and concave corners are kept sharp

items.name: Keep Boundaries
items.description: UVs are smoothed, boundaries are kept sharp

props.name: Quality
props.description: Accuracy of vertex positions, lower value is faster but less precise

props.name: Boundary Smooth
props.description: Controls how open boundaries are smoothed

items.name: Keep Corners
items.description: Smooth boundaries, but corners are kept sharp

props.name: Levels
props.description: Number of subdivisions to use in the viewport

props.name: Sculpt Levels
props.description: Number of subdivisions to use in sculpt mode

props.name: Render Levels
props.description: The subdivision level visible at render time

props.name: Total Levels
props.description: Number of subdivisions for which displacements are stored

props.name: External
props.description: Store multires displacements outside the .blend file, to save memory

props.name: Optimal Display
props.description: Skip drawing/rendering of interior subdivided edges

props.name: Use Creases
props.description: Use mesh crease information to sharpen edges or corners

props.name: Use Custom Normals
props.description: Interpolates existing custom normals to resulting mesh

props.name: Sculpt Base Mesh
props.description: Make Sculpt Mode tools deform the base mesh while previewing the displacement of higher subdivision levels
